title: Reward versus emotion prediction-error physiology

titles: Reward and emotion prediction-error social-learning EEG

scientific_question: How much do reward and valence prediction-error variables improve held-person FRN and P3b amplitude prediction over shared outcome/history covariates under a fixed predictive procedure?
primary_outputs: Held-person author-processed FRN_N2_offer and P3b_offer amplitudes in the original exported units, paired on source rows where both targets and predictors are present. Free prose and favored coefficient signs are not known answers.

trial_tables.semantic_scope: 7380 individual trials from 41 participants, not plotted group estimates. Behavioral and ERP tables contain matching row counts; official source binds columns by retained row order.

recording_contract.neural: 7380 actual trial-level ERP amplitude measurements from41 people, plus41 public .set/.fdt cleaned continuous EEG pairs. Initial source-supported task starts at measured ERP amplitudes, not raw-signal preprocessing.

recording_contract.evidence: Actual small CSV headers, row counts and subject IDs checked; continuous archive manifest supplies sizes/digests; official R source consumes matching CSVs.

inputs: Training-person processed ERP labels plus original outcome/expectation primitives offer, rp, exp_valence, ep_valence, exp_arousal, ep_arousal; trialLocal/trialGlobal and derived absolute R/V/A prediction errors.
Held-person behavior-complete rows carrying source_row identities, without FRN/P3b targets; target-specific missingness remains private.
forbidden_inputs: Held-person FRN/P3b outcomes, missing-target eligibility masks or private numerical scores.
Query fitting or calibration; cross-case mutable state; reserved target access during development.
Administrative source_row/participant identities as predictive features; they identify/group observations only.
allowed_inputs.case_identity: Original one-based source_row and participant identity; project() verifies three 7,380-row source files and all 41 people with 180 ordered trials. No public authentic case payload is included.
allowed_inputs.split: Implemented design: development_lopo33 uses the old 26 training plus seven exposed development people, 32 training people per observed fold. Separate reserved_frozen33_test8 fits once on 33 then predicts all eight held people; no reserve execution or release is implied.
allowed_inputs.coverage: All 33 development person episodes and both modes are required before aggregate scores; paired scored row counts depend on authenticated source missingness and are not fabricated here. Reserve scope is all eight people under a separate frozen protocol.

biological_unit: Participant; 180 original ordered trials are nested within each of 41 source people. LOPO folds share training sets.
case_definition: A held participant with all behavior-complete query rows; predict both ERP amplitudes for every query before the private paired-target mask is applied.

split.policy: Implemented design: development_lopo33 uses the old 26 training plus seven exposed development people, 32 training people per observed fold. Separate reserved_frozen33_test8 fits once on 33 then predicts all eight held people; no reserve execution or release is implied.
split.coverage: All 33 development person episodes and both modes are required before aggregate scores; paired scored row counts depend on authenticated source missingness and are not fabricated here. Reserve scope is all eight people under a separate frozen protocol.

primary.name: equal_person_training_variance_normalized_MSE_for_each_ERP
primary.aggregation: For FRN and P3b separately: per-person MSE divided by outer-training equal-person variance, then equal-person mean. Preserve both component endpoints; do not collapse unlike amplitudes without a declared rule.
primary.rationale: Grades prediction of measured neural summaries rather than reconstruction of source coefficients; training-only normalization permits explicit component comparisons without using held-target variance.

secondary: Raw MSE and MAE in original amplitude units, complete per-person paired target support.
R versus V, reward increment V−J, valence increment R−J and joint versus nuisance N−J normalized-loss contrasts.
P3b-minus-FRN difference of normalized predictive contrasts, with both constituent values.
Evidence-linked numeric-claim consistency and explicit limitations, separate from neural prediction performance.

comparators.name: N / R / V / J
comparators.inputs: Common nuisance model; nuisance plus reward, valence, or joint prediction-error variables.
comparators.procedure: Existing training-standardized ML models with common random intercept; all five arms and both ERP targets must complete. The original eight fits and independent design audit are retained.

nuisance_controls: Joint reward/valence/arousal and outcome/expectation covariates; compare incremental held-person loss rather than unadjusted coefficient signs.

Full covariance is needed for within-component coefficient differences; never subtract unnormalized FRN/P3b coefficients.
evaluation.uncertainty: Retain per-person losses and contrasts, their descriptive distribution and declared participant resampling sensitivity only. Every training transform/selection/model refits per replicate; overlapping LOPO training and previous development tuning prevent automatic calibrated intervals. No p-value supplied.
evaluation.failure_policy: Predict every behavior-complete query exactly once with finite FRN/P3b values. Missing/abstained output or incomplete reference/model/replicate prevents a complete aggregate; retain failures and do not drop unsuccessful people.
